subject: Aligning VP & CIO time — proposal to consolidate into two short timeboxes

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Park <samantha.park@clearwater.ai>
Cc: Jason Li <jason.li@clearwater.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning VP & CIO time — proposal to consolidate into two short timeboxes

Hi Samantha / Jason,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to show Clearwater what Redwood Inference can do for the data pipelines and low-latency personalization use case you described. I want to propose a slightly different approach to the exec portion of the demo so we can respect Mark's calendar while still getting both the VP and CIO exposure you requested.

Quick ask: would your team consider consolidating the exec segment into two 30-minute timeboxes instead of one long 60–90 minute slot? The idea is:
- 30 min VP-focused deep-dive (business outcomes + cost/latency tradeoffs)
- 30 min CIO-focused technical handoff (security, data flow, SSO, on-prem options)

This lets Mark attend the CIO-focused 30-min block and a VP (or their delegate) attend the business block — or we can swap the order depending on availability. We've found this structure keeps exec time tight while allowing engineering teams to follow up with a longer workshop separately.

Proposed windows (PST):
• Tues Aug 17 — 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
• Wed Aug 18 — 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30

I'm attaching a one-pager and a short draft agenda to make it easier for Mark to decide which 30-minute slot to join. If none of those work we can map to Mark's preferred 30-minute anchor and we’ll compact the demonstration to fit.

Next steps: can you confirm which of the four 30-min windows would work for Mark + the VP, and whether you prefer VP then CIO or CIO then VP? I can then loop in Neha and Vivek on our side to lock the invite and share a mutual action plan.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0113
Redwood Inference

1) If Mark can only make one 30-min slot, we'd prioritize the CIO-focused technical handoff.
2) Our VP of Product, Elise Norton, prefers late-afternoon slots — she asked whether there is a 15:00–15:30 option on Aug 18.

I'll confirm with Mark and Elise and loop back by EOD tomorrow. I copied Lauren from Redwood since it sounds like she'll be helpful to coordinate calendars.

Appreciate the one-pager — helps a lot.

Neha / Vivek / Laura —

Looping you in to help lock the exec windows and prep the two timeboxes if Clearwater confirms. Samantha is confirming with Mark (CIO) and their VP of Product (Elise). Two important coordination points before we send a calendar hold:
- We should propose a turnkey 30-min run order (first 10 mins outcomes + 15 mins demo + 5 mins open Q) for the VP slot; for CIO slot flip to 5 mins outcomes + 20 mins architecture/deployment + 5 mins next steps.
- Prepare fallback coverage: if Mark can only do one slot, offer to have Vivek + one of our infra leads (Laura) join the CIO slot and Neha join the VP slot. If both executives join, we keep both 30-min slots.

I attached a mutual action plan draft so we can convert confirmation into an invite quickly. Neha — can you own the calendar invite + final MAP once Samantha confirms availability? Vivek / Laura — can you check availability for Aug 17/18 in case we need to escalate to a longer workshop?

I'll stand by for Samantha's confirmation.

Thanks,
Aditya
